clusters.title: Product Improvements and Bug Fixes
clusters.summary: This cluster groups three distinct user requests for the Tabby AI code completion tool: enhancing completion functionality with branched suggestions for different user actions, keeping documentation current with updated model recommendations, and resolving a connection issue in the Eclipse plugin. Each request addresses a different aspect of the product ecosystem.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Eclipse plugin connection to tabby-agent
sample_titles: Fix Eclipse plugin connection to tabby-agent
Precompute branched follow-up completion suggestions for accept and reject paths
Update recommended models documentation with current information
